Plus, unless you started playing yesterday, you have a pretty good idea of how the game will play going by footage alone. "You cannot judge because you haven't played it" is pure bullshit. I realise games are a mass cultural phenomenon, half the fun is banter and bonding with like-minded people so it makes sense to join a hate-bandwagon for a game you never played (or did play and enjoy), but for all of these reasons and many more, review scores cannot be trusted, unless you know for certain the author gives zero shit about creds... i.e. never.
